mapper.select: SELECT WF_INSTANCE_ID, WORKFLOW_ID, START_DATE, END_DATE, ERROR_FLAG, STATUS, ERROR_MESSAGE, PWF_INSTANCE_ID, TPWF_INSTANCE_ID FROM WF_INSTANCES WHERE WF_INSTANCE_ID = #{wfInstanceId}

SELECT WF_INSTANCE_ID, WORKFLOW_ID, START_DATE, END_DATE, ERROR_FLAG, STATUS, ERROR_MESSAGE, PWF_INSTANCE_ID, TPWF_INSTANCE_ID FROM WF_INSTANCES WHERE WORKFLOW_ID = #{workflowId} ORDER BY START_DATE DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WF_INSTANCES ( WF_INSTANCE_ID, WORKFLOW_ID, START_DATE, END_DATE, ERROR_FLAG, STATUS, ERROR_MESSAGE, PWF_INSTANCE_ID, TPWF_INSTANCE_ID ) VALUES ( #{wfInstanceId}, #{workflowId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{errorFlag}, #{status}, #{errorMessage}, #{parentWfInstanceId}, #{topParentInstanceId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE WF_INSTANCES SET END_DATE = #{endDate}, ERROR_FLAG = #{errorFlag}, STATUS = #{status}, ERROR_MESSAGE = #{errorMessage} WHERE WF_INSTANCE_ID = #{wfInstanceId}
UPDATE WF_INSTANCES SET START_DATE=#{startDate}, END_DATE = #{endDate}, STATUS = #{status}, ERROR_MESSAGE = #{errorMessage} WHERE WF_INSTANCE_ID = #{wfInstanceId}
